doi_match.title: Match on DOI
doi_match.description: When true, records sharing a DOI are merged. Recommended.

title_similarity_threshold.title: Title similarity threshold
title_similarity_threshold.description: Records whose normalized titles are this similar or higher are considered duplicates (0.0–1.0). 0.95 is a strict default.

author_overlap_threshold.title: Author overlap threshold
author_overlap_threshold.description: Minimum fraction of authors that must overlap to count as a duplicate (0.0–1.0).
